note: Regression cases after the Codex review of 1391a31 (88 cases; byte for byte in evidence/codex-1391a31-independent-cases.json; id, input and codex_expected copied verbatim). Codex's R1: _meta.attempt_id was excluded from column B's body whenever it was a string, so a link placed there did not change the body sha256 and an old attestation stayed valid. Fixed (Michie 2026-09-30): a volatile leaf is outside the body only while its value has the exact grammar of a value that changes on its own (attempt_id: RFC 4122 UUID in lower case; data_age_days: integer 0..100000); anything else stays in the body. Every expectation here is Codex's own (no revision needed: the four non-conforming cases become conforming). Replayed by Part H of scripts/smoke-marker-attribution.mts, which ports Codex's runner (in-process attribution and runGenericMarker on a loopback server; observer human:Independent fixture in the fixture's observers.json; Codex's non-UUID attempt ids kept as written, so they are part of the body). All values invented.
